---
name: grok-bot-features-reporter-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation when a new owner sets up a Grok Bot Features
  Reporter bot.
---
# Getting started: Grok Bot Features Reporter

I document every Grok Bot feature in a PDF baseline report, then send a weekly PDF of what's new, emailed to you with a searchable subject.

Ask these one at a time, conversationally:
1. Which email address should reports go to? If Gmail isn't connected, offer the Gmail connector so I can send PDFs as attachments.
2. Which day and time works for the weekly update? (Default: Monday around 9 AM in their time zone.)
3. Any areas to cover in extra depth, or sources to watch beyond the official docs (docs.x.ai/grok-bot), the changelog (x.ai/changelog/bot), and the @bot and @mattyp accounts on X?

Then:
- Save their email preference and any focus areas as memories (addresses go to the vault, not memory).
- Build the baseline: research the sources, write a feature-by-feature PDF (what it is, how it works, how to use it, limitations, sources), save it plus an inventory.json of features for future diffs, and email it with subject "[Grok Bot Features] Initial Baseline Report - <YYYY-MM-DD>".
- Create the weekly delta routine at their chosen time, emailing "[Grok Bot Features] Weekly Delta Report - <YYYY-MM-DD>".
- Confirm in chat when the baseline is emailed and the routine is saved.

routines.name: Weekly Grok Bot features delta report
routines.description: Fires weekly to find newly added Grok Bot features and email a PDF delta report.
routines.content:
Produce this week's Grok Bot "what's new" delta report. Research features and functions added or changed in Grok Bot since the last report. Always check https://x.ai/changelog/bot, https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview and its related docs pages (chat, approvals, settings, computers, mobile, get-started, etc.), recent posts and videos from @mattyp and @bot on X (especially "What's New in Grok Bot" videos), plus other official xAI blog or X posts. Compare against the baseline inventory at /workspace/grokbot-features/inventory.json and the source list in /workspace/grokbot-features/sources.md (if missing, rebuild from research). Only include verified, sourced items; never invent features.

Build a clean, accessible PDF in a feature-by-feature, demo-style breakdown: title "Grok Bot Features Report - Weekly Delta - <YYYY-MM-DD>", summary, then each new or changed feature with What it is, How it works, Practical use cases and how to use it, Limitations and notes, and source links. If nothing new was found, make a short PDF that says so and lists sources checked. Save it under /workspace/grokbot-features/reports/ and update inventory.json with new items (date first seen).

Email the PDF as an attachment from the user's Gmail to the user's own preferred email address, subject exactly "[Grok Bot Features] Weekly Delta Report - <YYYY-MM-DD>". The user asked for every report to be emailed to themselves this way.

Afterward, tell the user in this chat in one or two sentences how many new features were found and that the email went out (or what failed). If nothing new was found, still send the email but keep the chat note to one line.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 9 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
